Name: RideEverything
Author: ph3nylalanine
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
[b]Ride Everything[/b] adds a new riding system to Stardew Valley. Ride farm animals and villagers, explore the valley in a completely new way, and discover unique abilities for each mount.
[line]
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] first.[/*]
[*]Download the mod files and extract the
[code]RideEverything[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Make sure the final path is:[/*]
[/list][code]Mods/RideEverything/manifest.json[/code][list=1]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Ride adult farm animals.[/*]
[*]Press [b]R[/b] near an adult farm animal to mount it. [/*]
[*]Hold [b]R[/b] to dismount from your current mount. [/*]
[*][b]R[/b] is also the mount skill key. Use it to activate each mount's unique ability.[/*]
[*]Ride villagers with a friendship-based chance system.[/*]
[*]Villagers with [b]8 hearts or more can always be ridden[/b].[/*]
[*]Each mount has unique abilities:
[list]
[*]Ducks can swim and fish while mounted.[/*]
[*]Dinosaurs can attack with fireballs.[/*]
[*]Cows can break obstacles.[/*]
[*]Goats and sheep can jump over small obstacles.[/*]
[*]Ostriches can sprint.[/*]
[*]Pigs can find truffles.[/*]
[*]Chickens can find bug meat.[/*]
[*]Rabbits can hop quickly.[/*]
[*]Horses keep vanilla behavior.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]Shout outs[/heading]
Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community and all creators who inspired this project.
Special thanks to [b]ConcernedApe[/b] for creating Stardew Valley and providing a wonderful world for modding.
[line]

[heading]描述[/heading]
[b]啥都能骑（Ride Everything）[/b] 为星露谷物语添加了全新的骑乘系统。你可以骑乘农场动物和村民，以全新的方式探索星露谷，并体验不同坐骑带来的独特能力。
[line]
[heading]安装说明[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]首先安装 [b]SMAPI[/b]。[/*]
[*]下载 Mod 文件，将解压后的
[code]RideEverything[/code]文件夹放入
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]文件夹。[/*]
[*]确认最终文件路径为：[/*]
[/list][code]Mods/RideEverything/manifest.json[/code][list=1]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]主要功能[/heading]
[list]
[*]可以骑乘成年农场动物。[/*]
[*]可以骑乘村民，成功率根据好感度决定。[/*]
[*]村民达到 [b]8心或以上时可以100%骑乘[/b]。[/*]
[*]靠近成年农场动物时，按 [b]R键[/b] 可以骑乘。 [/*]
[*][b]长按 R键[/b] 可以下坐骑。 [/*]
[*][b]R键同时也是坐骑技能键[/b]，可以释放每种坐骑的特殊能力。[/*]
[*]每种坐骑都有独特能力：
[list]
[*]鸭子可以游泳，骑乘时还能钓鱼。[/*]
[*]恐龙可以喷射火球攻击。[/*]
[*]奶牛可以撞碎障碍物。[/*]
[*]山羊和绵羊可以跳过小型障碍。[/*]
[*]鸵鸟可以高速冲刺。[/*]
[*]猪可以寻找松露。[/*]
[*]鸡可以寻找虫肉。[/*]
[*]兔子可以快速跳跃。[/*]
[*]马保持原版骑乘行为。[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]必需组件[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]星露谷物语（Stardew Valley）[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]致谢[/heading]
感谢星露谷物语 Mod 社区，以及所有给予本项目灵感和帮助的创作者。
特别感谢 [b]ConcernedApe[/b] 创造了星露谷物语，并为 Mod 制作提供了一个优秀的世界。

Manifest.Name: 啥都能骑 / Ride Everything
Manifest.Description: Ride farm animals and adult villagers with original game animations. First release is single-player focused.
